content.short: 300DAO is a community of 300 investors pooling capital to invest in disruptive Web3 technologies and founders.
content.description: 300DAO democratizes access to venture deals for the average crypto enthusiast or founder by building a community of crypto-native builders who collaborate to review and share deal flow. Deal opportunities come from a leading Web3 venture partner, and the 300DAO team conducts due diligence to deliver a streamlined investment process. This setup reduces friction and decision time for members, enabling founders to stay focused on building while members participate in well-vetted opportunities.
content.meta: 300DAO lets 300 investors pool capital to access curated Web3 venture deals across multiple chains. Discover 300DAO and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: A Syndicate of Three Hundred Investors
resources.tldr: Members co-invest at pre-seed and seed alongside larger funds, with diligence handled centrally rather than by each member.
